text:
maria_csm: Heads-up — SigmaPulse (mid-market, trial -> paid 2 months ago) showing strong seat adoption then plateaued last 3 weeks. CSAT survey came back: 6/10 with comment 'product misses a few core reporting flows for finance team'. I think this is a product-fit / enablement gap, and we should roll a short escalation quickplay to avoid renewal risk.

liam_success: Agree we should move quickly. Do we have signals on usage (which features dropped) and any open support tickets?

maria_csm: Usage: active seats stable but query volume down ~55% (historical report dashboard). Top dropped flows: bulk report export, scheduled report reliability. There is 1 open ticket (ID 87921) about CSV export corrupt rows. No recorded feature-flag changes on our side.

nate_onboarding: I can run a 30-min office-hours for their power users and ops team this week. Suggested agenda: 1) validate current workflows, 2) quick wins for export, 3) map missing reporting fields. Want to invite product PMs?

maria_csm: Yes invite @product_pm and @eng_oncall for quick triage. Timeline: immediate triage + 7-day enablement + 21-day health checkpoint before renewal touch. Owner assignment below.

liam_success: What's the short checklist for the triage quickplay? Keep it lightweight.

maria_csm: Checklist (short):
```
- Triage call within 48h (CS + Eng + PM)
- Collect 3 sample export files and failing query IDs
- Reproduce export corrupt rows in staging
- Temporary mitigation: provide CSV workaround + export script until fix
- Enable targeted in-app banner with 'reporting help' link
- Run enablement office-hours within 7 days
- Weekly health pulse (usage + NPS + support queue) for 3 weeks
- If no recovery in 21 days -> renewal escalates to AE + solutions engineering
```

iris_support: I created a private KB note and uploaded sample CSVs to the case. Added reproduction steps to ticket 87921. Also added a quick temporary script snippet they can run.

psa_bot: Ticket 87921 updated by iris_support. SLA: 48h triage requested.

nate_onboarding: I'll draft an invite and slide deck focused on the export workaround + mapping missing fields. Can share a recording for their distributed team.

liam_success: For measurement — define success criteria for the 21-day checkpoint?

maria_csm: Success criteria (measurable):
- Query volume >= 85% of baseline OR clear adoption plan agreed with timelines
- Open support tickets related to reporting = 0 or mitigation accepted by customer
- NPS on post-enablement poll >= 7 OR AE signs off on contract health

liam_success: Cool. Anything from product re: roadmap?

maria_csm: Product PM indicated a ticket in backlog for improved exports but no ETA. We should push for a short-term patch and communicate roadmap transparency to the customer.

nate_onboarding: Proposed owners: Maria = CS lead (owner of play), Nate = enablement lead, Iris = support lead, Eng Oncall = triage owner, Liam = renewal observer. I'll put owners in the invite.

maria_csm: I'm going to run a quick opt-in banner template for the customer to surface the office-hours link. ETA: 24h.

liam_success: After office-hours, let's have a 15-min sync to decide whether AE should offer a one-month credit or extended onboarding (if adoption < threshold).

maria_csm: Agreed. Also capture feedback for product (feature gaps list) and include in the renewal playbook so AE negotiation has concrete asks.

iris_support: Done — KB + ticket updated + temp script shared. Noted to attach bug repro to triage call.

psa_bot: Calendar event created: SigmaPulse - Reporting Triage (nate_onboarding invited). Event time: in 36 hours.

maria_csm: Thanks team. I'll post the office-hours link + short customer note after the triage. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can make the triage call.

liam_success: :thumbsup:

nate_onboarding: :thumbsup:

iris_support: :thumbsup:

maria_csm: (follow-up) Quick note: AE asked that we prepare a one-page recovery plan they can share with the customer execs if needed. I'll draft and post it here.
